title: Summary-view obligation assessments: test the re-read, not-carried, notice and no-history wording, and a later page whose record position changes
outcome: Every summary-view wording branch in src/acceptance_obligation_assessment.rs has a test: the missing_continuation re-read text ('must_show rows a-b, already listed'), the not-carried line and the notice for a summary record (complete 'N rows, M must_show' and incomplete 'an unread must_show row'), and the branch with no `history` command; plus a later summary page whose record_position changes stopping as assessment_changed.
acceptance: Summary-view obligation assessments: test the re-read, not-carried, notice and no-history wording, and a later page whose record position changes is done
